contentItem.title: 直径：经过圆心的线段
contentItem.englishTitle: A diameter of the circle is any straight line drawn through the centre and terminated in both directions by the circumference of the circle, and such a straight line also bisects the circle.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A diameter of the circle is any straight line drawn through the centre and terminated in both directions by the circumference of the circle, and such a straight line also bisects the circle.
圆的直径是指通过圆心线,由圆的环形两侧划断的任何直线,这种直线也使圆形两分。（相关点与线段：A）
